boundary.reason: Definition of done requires one real private request -> durable authorized work -> correlated sanitized result canary. Mocking the canary would not satisfy E2E acceptance.
boundary.safe_next: Run the real canary from an already-linked Primary Chat browser session, then complete the browser-side opaque correlation preservation without exposing raw text.
